morbi.headline: Morbi cluster shows premium-led recovery amidst export volume contraction and fraud risks.
what_changed: Varmora Granito reported H1 profit surge driven by premium tile margins, indicating sector recovery for larger players.
Indian ceramic tile exports experienced a steep 46% volume drop during April-July 2026 with a weak FY27 outlook.
A Morbi tile manufacturer faced a credit fraud incident involving a Mumbai buyer defaulting on Rs 44.74 lakh.
stress_signals: Export volume drop of 46% between April and Jul 2026 threatens export-reliant MSMEs [434975bd08e0].
Liquidity and counterparty risk highlighted by a Rs 44.74 lakh credit fraud involving a vanished buyer [29ed75c6450d].
improvement_signals: Varmora Granito financial results and 498% H1 profit jump point to recovery driven by premium tiles [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c].
what_to_watch: Whether recovery indicators extend from large branded players to smaller MSME vitrified and wall tile producers.
Export volume trends and overseas demand recovery for the remainder of FY27.
Counterparty credit checks, receivables management, and buyer verification protocols for outstation orders.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe input costs and loom shutdowns amid mixed trade developments.
what_changed: Surat loom units face early closures and a month-long shutdown due to a 50% raw material cost spike and yarn price hikes.
Embroidery sector faces a prolonged three-month impasse with worker detentions and ongoing agitation.
GST Council provided relief by granting Input Tax Credit refunds and easing highway inspections.
stress_signals: 50% raw material cost spike and ₹50/kg yarn price hike driving month-long loom shutdowns affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6, b567711c9ed4].
Embroidery sector facing ongoing stress, worker detentions, and a prolonged three-month impasse impacting job-work cash velocity [7697e96a190e, 29331b975c9e, e7921383cbb7].
Diamond sector reports a 7% drop in polished diamond shipments and a payment default of Rs 70,000 in polishing wages [698c779932f2, 975918f112f3].
Operational disruptions from eight-hour power cuts and a fire at the Adinath Textile Market in Salabatpura [f36719f0f644, 167f80ff6cdc].
improvement_signals: Textile industry expects export growth opportunities via the India-New Zealand FTA [8e92d85d894d].
Cluster expanding into defence technical textiles and ICA-GemLab opening its first Indian lab in Surat [0f163b499572, 26bd1ecd549c].
GST Council grants ITC refunds and eases highway checks for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
what_to_watch: Monitor debt-servicing capacity and working capital utilization of loom and embroidery units facing early Diwali closures.
Track implementation details of the upcoming state/central textile policies and power cut resolutions.
Watch account-level cash flows and payment defaults in the diamond polishing and trading segments.
